# v3.16-dev

Automated checking for the installation and update scripts. Nothing in the app
changes; this is about catching mistakes in the scripts that run on your server
before they ever reach it.

## New

- **The installation and update scripts are now checked automatically on every
  change**, the same way the application code already was. Until now they were
  the one part of the system with no automated checking at all — despite being
  the part that runs with administrator rights on your machine. They are now
  syntax-checked, run through a linter pinned to a fixed version, and covered by
  a suite of tests exercising the parts that set file ownership and permissions.

- **Tests covering how the updater repairs the files it shares with the
  application** — refusing to follow a symbolic or hard link planted at one of
  their names, and repairing a file in place so an existing update log is never
  lost.

- **Tests for the reader that handles your configuration file**, against
  realistic content (quoted values, passwords containing an equals sign, Windows
  line endings, a missing final newline) and against each safety rule it applies
  to a custom certificate bundle — including confirming it still **accepts** the
  ordinary kind, so a future tightening cannot quietly break installs behind a
  corporate proxy.

- **Values that must match exactly between the application and the update
  scripts are now compared by running both sides**, rather than by reading them.
  If they ever drift apart, updates or scheduled jobs stop working silently —
  this makes that fail loudly instead, at the point someone introduces it.

## Worth knowing

The test suite includes a tool that deliberately breaks the scripts to confirm
the tests can still detect it. An early version of that tool reported success on
a machine where nothing was working at all, which is exactly the failure it
exists to prevent — it now refuses to report anything unless it has first
confirmed the unbroken scripts pass and that a deliberately harmless change goes
undetected.
